title: tc-review-conflict
description: Two reviewers disagree: both verdicts with who gave them, resolved by a third person with a reason, or kept blind.

heading.description: The heading, and the group's name

scope.description: A quiet line under the heading, e.g. the document or queue the item is from

item.description: What was reviewed, quoted at the top – a claim, a finding, a row

reviews.description: The two reviews, in the order to show them

difference.description: The difference in one sentence; unset, it's written from the verdicts

blind.description: The reviewers' view: identities and verdicts are hidden, only that a conflict exists is shown

viewer.description: In blind mode, the id of the review that belongs to the person looking – they see their own verdict

resolvable.description: The person looking may resolve it. Default true; false shows the conflict read-only

resolver.description: The resolver's name, recorded with the resolution when the element sets it

verdict.description: The verdict in a word or two – "Supported", "Not supported"

tone.description: The verdict's colour: positive (green), negative (red) or neutral (gray). Default neutral

at.description: When, as the app words it – "Today 09:14"
